decisions.rationale: ROOT independently reproduced that git_safety.py changed from the protected baseline while the sole C1-locked shared-code dependency map lists only lane_controller.py and README.md. The map therefore cannot justify inheriting every protected baseline ID affected by importing git_safety.py. This is release-blocking evidence incompleteness under C73, and the bounded correction is materially cheaper and safer than accepting an unproved regression boundary.
decisions.smallest_fix: Preserve the historical S1 map; add a candidate-wide exact-tip dependency-map supplement covering git_safety.py and its nine protected test_git_results.py IDs, run only those nine IDs, reconcile the registry, then follow the required fresh C0/C1 and dependency-invalidated C2 route without changing candidate or MCP source.
